dedupe_keys.name: hvcb tcc twin digital twin calibration of high voltage circuit breaker trip coils from open field data

description: Israel Gondres Torné at the State University of Amazonas publishes HVCB TCC Twin, a calibration pipeline for high-voltage circuit-breaker trip-coil actuators. It estimates parameters from field trip-coil-current signals by inverting a hybrid electromechanical model. The description includes simulated-ground-truth checks of the landmark extractor, parameter-identifiability analysis, Type A and Type B uncertainty components, a Bayesian posterior and a failure-to-trip margin map. Zenodo archives version 1.1.0 in July 2026 as a ZIP under MIT, with free public access. Geographic coverage, implementation language and runtime dependencies are not stated in the deposit. The model supports circuit-breaker digital-twin and reliability simulations, but its uncertainty and calibration claims were not independently tested. A separately linked field-condition dataset supplies related evidence. No catalogue record explicitly includes this calibration tool. The archive was not opened or executed.
